course_name_en:
KMM4840 
A




— Vocational Training in Business 4

learning_outcomes.text: Students will closely recognize the working areas of the chemical engineering program and increase their business experience by engaging in applications that reinforce the knowledge and skills they gained during their education.
Students will gain a sense of professional duty and responsibility.
Students will gain the ability to work in harmony with business personnel as a team and develop effective communication skills.
Students will recognize technological developments in their field and gain the ability to evaluate industrial applications, prepare, and present reports.

syllabus_topics: The course content is created by the in-company training staff and the responsible faculty member of the department based on the activities the student will carry out in the company as part of the vocational training in business.
